name: Hacktoberfest 2026
what_you_do: In October you can join online challenges and livestreams, or go to one of over 500 local in-person fests. This year the event focuses on open source and open-weight AI.
who_can_apply: Open to everyone. The page does not state an age limit. In 2026, pull requests no longer count toward rewards.
deadline_text: Hacktoberfest 2026 ended Oct 31, 2026. It ran all of October. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The 2026 event is over. Check the official site next fall for how to sign up.
notes: 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 4, 2026. The page says only that organizers want to do it again. The page states no age limit; check each local fest for age rules.
